claim.summary: Restriction degree barrier, functions on the cube identified with multilinear polynomials. (a) Over any field, for f_1..f_k on {0,1}^n with common zero set Z, any map A: {0,1}^L -> {0,1}^n and T >= 0: if deg(1_Z o A) <= T then A^(-1)(Z) is empty or has at least 2^(L-T) points (over F_2, 1_Z o A = prod_j (1 + f_j o A)). Over F_2: (b) for uniform independent affine forms l_1..l_k and every affine map A whose image has dimension L, the forms restricted to the image are uniform independent, the conjunction indicator has degree equal to the rank of their linear parts when consistent and is 0 otherwise, and Pr[degree <= k - 1] = 1 - prod_(i<k) (1 - 2^(i-L)) <= (2^k - 1) 2^(-L); so for every distribution on affine maps with images of dimension at least L some fixed k forms keep degree k except with that probability. (c) For 1 <= k < L_0 <= n and M >= ((n - L_0)(n + 1) + n)/(L_0 - k), M independent such conjunctions have, except with probability (n - L_0 + 1) 2^(-n), no affine subspace of dimension at least L_0 on which all have degree <= k - 1. (d) A line, a disjunction of r members each a conjunction of k_i >= 1 of K = sum k_i independent uniform affine equations, has falsity indicator prod_i (1 + 1_(Z_i)) of degree exactly K under such A, with no member constant, except with probability (2^K - 1) 2^(-L); (b) and (c) hold for lines with K in place of k. (e) For a CNF F of N clauses of width at most w on n variables and any PCK^1_(F_2) refutation R of size S, weakening and cut give a refutation of size S + O(N M_0 r (w + K n)) in which lines {C, m_1..m_r} on the clauses C that R uses are ancestors of the final line; for M_0 = 1 and every distribution on affine maps with images of dimension at least L >= w + K + 1, some fixed forms leave every padded line below degree K with probability at most (2^K - 1) 2^(-(L-w)); for w + K < L_0 and M_0 >= ((n - L_0)(n + 1) + n)/(L_0 - w - K), except with probability (n - L_0 + 1) 2^(-n), every affine subspace of dimension at least L_0 carries a padded line of degree at least K.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed with corrections by a fresh-context medium reviewer in two rounds: (a) by the minimum-distance induction over any field, (b) by surjectivity of B^T and the rank count with averaging over the distribution, (c) by a union over affine subspaces, (d) by expanding the line's falsity into intersection indicators, (e) by weakening and cut (BKZ Definition 11) and a product over disjoint variables. Exact degree on the cube only; modulo the restricted instance's pseudoideal the padded lines are multiples of clause axioms and vanish once their degree is at most the pseudoideal's.

formalization.scope: Informal proof or computation; no Lean verification.

significance.rationale: Exact simplification of every line of a collapsed refutation by an affine restriction, oblivious or chosen after the refutation, fails already for lines of affine equations, whose restricted degree is the rank of the restricted forms, and such lines enter any refutation of a CNF at polynomial cost; so in exact degree on the cube that step is at least as strong as the lower bound. Modulo the restricted instance's pseudoideal the padded lines, multiples of clause axioms, vanish once their degree is at most the pseudoideal's, so that reading stays open.

claim.summary: Modular counting collapse (Buss-Kolodziejczyk-Zdanowski, Trans. AMS 367 (2015), Theorems 43 and 45 and Proposition 47, author-hosted journal version): for p prime and a Sigma_3(oplus_p^-) formula phi = OR_k AND_l psi_{k,l} of Sigma-size <= S with a depth-d PK_{oplus_p} proof of size <= S, the cedents of the complements {bar psi_{k,0},...,bar psi_{k,L_k-1}} have a dag-like PCK^1_p refutation of Sigma-size S^(log^e S), e depending only on d; the analogous PCK^1_{F_p} refutation of the polynomial translations is stated after the theorem with its proof left to the reader. Sigma-size S bounds size by S, every conjunction or disjunction of literals by log S literals and every polynomial degree below log S. For Sigma_2 phi there are a term t = O(S^(log^e S)) and a PV_2^{oplus_p P} function f, depending on d, phi and the proof, such that the cedents with axioms {f(u) != v}_{u<t} (v given by 2 log t new variables) have a tree-like PCK^0_p (and PCK^0_{F_p}) refutation of the same Sigma-size. Proposition 47: for unsatisfiable p_1..p_n of degree <= d over F_p and t = t(n, 2^d) quasipolynomial, there is q of degree poly(log n, d) in poly(log n, d) new variables, zero under every old assignment for all but a 1/t fraction of the new assignments, with {p_i} plus q refutable in Nullstellensatz degree poly(log n, d); proof sketched for p = 2, part (d) left to the reader.
claim.assessment: Imported established results, read in the author-hosted journal version: Definitions 1-4 and 11-13, Lemma 15, Theorems 25, 26, 42, 43 and 45 with their remarks, the proof of Theorem 46(b), the closing remarks of Section 6 and Proposition 47; the negation bars of Theorem 43 checked on the rendered page. The reflection-principle proofs were not checked. PK_{oplus_p} is the authors' Tait-style system; conversion from other bounded-depth modular Frege presentations is not part of the import. Medium reviewer passed after corrections.

formalization.scope: Informal proof or computation; no Lean verification.

significance.rationale: Supplies a depth-free proof system for the binary target at quasipolynomial cost, and a barrier: axioms false only on a 1/t fraction of the assignments to polylogarithmically many new variables, for every old assignment, make every unsatisfiable system refutable in polylog Nullstellensatz degree.

claim.summary: Depth-free modular target: let F_N be unsatisfiable CNFs of size N, clauses as cedents of literals, and phi'_N = OR_k AND_l oplus^1_2{neg lit_{k,l}} the CNF-negation tautology with negated literals as one-input oplus_2 formulas. If for every constant c, for all large N, no dag-like PCK^1_{F_2} refutation of F_N has Sigma-size 2^((log N)^c), then for every fixed d and A >= 2, for all large N, phi'_N has no depth-d PK_{oplus_2} proof of size at most N^A. The same holds for tree-like PCK^0_{F_2} if the hypothesis covers refutations of F_N with the axioms {f(u) != v}_{u<t} of every PV_2^{oplus_2 P} function f and every quasipolynomial t. The hypothesis is superquasipolynomial in one fixed system, stronger in size than the goal needs; reaching the goal's Frege presentation needs a conversion not proved here.
claim.assessment: Working one-step composition of imp:modular-counting-collapse at p = 2: a size-N^A proof gives Sigma-size 2^((A log N)^(e+1)) < 2^((log N)^(e+2)) once log N > A^(e+1), base-2 logarithms; the complement of a wrapped literal is equivalent to the literal by constant-size proofs. Passed by the medium reviewer after corrections. Conversion from the plain tautology and from the goal's Frege presentation is assumed, not proved; no lower bound for the collapsed systems is known to the record.

claim.summary: Degree-two pin reduction (a sufficient condition): over any field, n >= 3, for FPHP^m_n plus affine pins L_k = l_k + c_k = q_k, if (i) the linear parts l_k are independent modulo row sums and (ii) the multiplication map V^h -> R_2, (lambda_k) -> sum lambda_k l_k, has only Koszul kernel, where V is the cell space modulo row sums and R_2 is the direct sum over pairs of rows of zero-diagonal n x n matrices modulo row and column sums (dim R_2 = C(m,2)(n^2-3n+1)), then there is no Nullstellensatz refutation of degree 2. The affine degree-2 consequences of the rows are only their span (one relation per pair of rows, n >= 3). Condition (ii) needs hm(n-1) - C(h,2) <= dim R_2, a margin D_1 - h below the model's fill point, so the lemma is sufficient, not necessary; (ii) itself is open.
claim.assessment: Working proof of the sufficient condition, after a fresh-context review. Condition (ii) is freeness of the functional top algebra through degree 2 (prop:syzygies-as-tor); on the weak base prop:one-count-by-freeness with thm:general-forms-freeness already gives generic pins PC hardness at every constant degree (pin freeness record entry).

formalization.scope: Informal proof or computation; no Lean verification.

significance.rationale: Degree-2 Nullstellensatz case, on the functional base, of the recorded freeness-to-hardness route; the weak-base PC version at every degree is recorded (prop:one-count-by-freeness).
